title: Decision 333 service-revenue calculation as written
applicability: Only the identified activity, relationship and cited primary-source scope.
requirement: As written in Decision 333/BOL, effective March 29, 2024, services have a minimum repatriation of 80% within 60 days from export, with contractual payment due within the decision’s 180-day maximum. Article 7 requires minimum sale to the banking system of 20% of that minimum repatriation amount within three working days after credit to the specific account. If not sold in time, Article 7’s continuation provides notice and bank purchase of the shortfall on the following working day. Article 5 allows periodic adjustment; where the minimum or timing cannot be met, relevant documents must substantiate the request to the Foreign Exchange Management Department for case-by-case consideration. These dated instrument figures are not an approved present classification or later-implementation clearance for royalties/support fees.
exceptions: Article 5 adjustment/case-consideration provisions and Article 7 special re-export branch remain separate. No automatic waiver or netting right is inferred.
deadline: As written: service minimum within 60 days from export; minimum sale within three working days of account credit; following-working-day shortfall purchase after notice.
renewal: Recheck when facts or the operative source changes
evidence: Actual underlying source and transaction facts
legalStatus: Verified reading of the dated decision; later implementation and transaction classification conditional
interpretationLimits: Do not apply the service branch to an IP royalty or mixed payment merely because the business calls itself a service company.
